preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM question WHERE prompt = 'True or False: A primary key can contain NULL values.') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM answer_option WHERE content = 'False') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM answer_attempt WHERE (question_id = (SELECT id FROM question WHERE prompt = 'Define the term "Atomicity" in the context of database transactions.') AND provided_text = 'Answer for the question.') OR (answer_option_id = ( SELECT ao.id FROM answer_option ao JOIN question q ON ao.question_id = q.id WHERE q.prompt = 'True or False: A primary key can contain NULL values.' AND ao.content = 'False' ));
